'''Old Warris''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] villager and member of the [[Myyydril]] tribe. He lived in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] along with the rest of his tribe, within the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Old Warris appeared as a non-player character in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|Rage of the Wookiees]], an expansion for the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
